name: flow-spec-planning
description: Author Flow chapter specifications and task worksheets, verify completion from disk, run write-time OKF validation, flag degraded-model plans, and run zero-context spec review.

bundle_root.description: Bundle directory path relative to workspace or absolute main checkout (default .agents/bundles).

planner_mode.description: Batch 1-3 chapters in one warm planner or fan out one planner per chapter (default auto).

planner_model.description: Preferred planner model option (default inherit when session is Pro/Pro-Next, or pass pro when session is Flash; falls back to flash on quota).

reviewer_model.description: Preferred spec-reviewer model option (default inherit when session is Pro/Pro-Next, or pass pro when session is Flash; falls back to flash on quota).

planner_agent.description: Optional custom agent profile for planning (default self).

disk_idle_grace_seconds.description: Idle seconds after all chapter files exist on disk before recovering a stalled planner (default 90).
